description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'MultiException' that aggregates multiple root causes (throwables). It is used to handle scenarios where multiple operations may fail, and the exception propagates all causes together, providing detailed messages and stack traces.

classes.name: MultiException
classes.description: A custom exception class that encapsulates multiple underlying causes (throwables), allowing collective handling and detailed reporting of multiple errors.

methods.name: MultiException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and a list of problems (throwables).

methods.name: MultiException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a list of problems, generating a default message.

methods.name: getCauses
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the underlying throwables.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed message including all underlying causes' stack traces.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace of the exception and its causes to standard error.
